deep down to my heart’s core! Ridiculous creatures! Wanting to be gods, they're doomed to being just what they are! I could have laid back eons ago and lived like a god, except that I felt the need to benefit the best of them. Ah, but then I saw what they had done, and it was as if I’d never advised them.

@@U03560@@
True, Old Man of the Sea, but we trust you all the same. Youre the sage, after all, so don't send us packing. See this flame? Human enough, I admit, but ready to follow your every advice unconditionally.

@@U03562@@
Advice! Ha! What advice ever counted with men! Wise words, deaf ears! Always the same! They do things, condemn them afterwards, and remain as headstrong as ever, this tribe we call men! What more could I have done for Paris than give him a fatherly warning? But lust had its way, and so he ensnared the Spartan 海伦. He stood there boldly on the Grecian shore as I told him the vision I foresaw: air full of smoke, torrents of red, roof beams blazing, death and murder down below—
translation:
@@U03558@@
深入我的心底！可笑的生物！想要成为神，就注定要成为神！我本可以在很久以前就悠闲地生活，像神一样生活，只是我觉得有必要让他们中最好的人受益。啊，但后来我看到他们做了什么，就好像我从来没有劝过他们一样。

@@U03560@@
是的，海中老人，但我们仍然相信你。毕竟你是圣人，所以不要让我们打包。看到这火焰了吗？我承认，很人性化，但准备无条件遵循你的每一个建议。

@@U03562@@
忠告！哈!对于男人来说，忠告多么重要啊！智慧之言，充耳不闻！总是一样！他们做事，事后谴责，然后仍然像以前一样任性，这个部落我们称之为男人！除了给帕里斯发出慈父般的警告之外，我还能为帕里斯做些什么呢？但情欲得逞，他就陷害了斯巴达人海伦。当我告诉他我预见到的景象时，他勇敢地站在希腊海岸上：空气中充满烟雾，红色洪流，屋顶横梁熊熊燃烧，下面是死亡和谋杀——
